webinar.title: Who Decides When You Can't?

promises: What really happens in Colorado if you die or can't make decisions, and how to keep your family out of court
The overlooked pieces that undo good plans: beneficiaries, titles, and a trust with nothing in it
A simple checklist to know exactly where your plan stands today
who: You have an old will, or none at all
You've meant to get to it for years
You have a trust and aren't sure it's set up right
Someone in your family needs extra care, or you're a blended family
